SECTION 1.     Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all of the Bl-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown

on Map No. 15-G in an area bound by:




A line 56.38 feet north of and parallel to West Norwood Avenue; North Broadway; a line 31.38 feet north

of and parallel to West Norwood Avenue; the alley next west of and parallel to North Broadway.
